title: Pretty But Cheap Quality
text: Pretty But Cheap Quality. This is a pretty stone, from a distance. Up close the flaws stand out badly. Cracks in the base and sides, chips on the edges, uneven grinding. There's even a plug in one of the flat areas (clearly visible in my photos). I don't mind this for my decorations but I'd be embarrassed to give this as a gift to someone.
